anomalies.observed: R9 is a 0 Ω part connecting the two servo signal nets directly. Both servo signal pins (J1 pin 3 for channel 1 and J7 pin 3 for channel 2) are tied together, and each is also fed from its own 1 kΩ series resistor (R21, R22) from a separate GPIO net.
anomalies.expected: The spec says PWM mode gives two independent channels, with the servo signal pins bridged only in serial mode, via the R13/R14 jumpers. A jumper that bridges the two servo signal pins should not be populated in PWM mode.

evidence.quote: PWM mode (populate R3/R4 ... leave R13/R14 open): each servo header's signal pin gets its own independent 1 kΩ-buffered GPIO line
R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode the two channel GPIO drivers (through R21 and R22) are shorted together at the servo signal pins. Both servos receive the same signal, and the two GPIO outputs can fight each other.

anomalies.observed: R14 is 2.2k, connected between the MAX3485 B line and GND. It is not a 0 Ω jumper and does not bridge to the servo signal bus. The B line is also pulled up through R18 (2.2k to +3V3), so B sits at a divided mid-level instead of being a defined bus line.
anomalies.expected: The spec lists R13 and R14 as 0 Ω jumpers that, when shorted in serial mode, bridge the servo signal pins onto the MAX3485 TTL bus.

evidence.quote: R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus

anomalies.impact: Serial mode may not reach the bus through the intended path. The B side of the transceiver is referenced to a divider instead of the servo line, which can degrade half-duplex communication and the bus failsafe.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows a 0 Ω short (R9) directly joining the two servo signal pins, which contradicts the spec's independent-channel PWM mode, and R14 is a 2.2k bias resistor where the spec calls for a 0 Ω bus jumper. The reference designators in the spec and netlist do not match closely, so these findings are only moderately confident.
